request.text:
INC-8421 · 8 October 2026, 10:15
From: Maya Chen, Payroll Operations
The payroll portal is unavailable for all 18 members of the payroll team. The page shows 'SSO authentication failed'. We cannot submit this month's payroll; the bank cutoff is 14:00 today. There is no workaround. Other departments can still use the intranet. Assigned engineer: Arjun Shah. Arjun proposed rolling back this morning's identity configuration change. The change manager has not approved that rollback yet. No restoration estimate is available.
request.instructions: Severity rubric: Low = routine request with no service impact; Medium = degraded work with a usable workaround; High = work blocked for a team without a usable workaround; Critical = a company-wide service outage. Major-incident criteria: a company-wide outage OR a business-critical team blocked without a workaround while a stated same-day deadline is at risk. Approval must be explicit. Use only this report; leave extracted details blank when absent. Generated updates must distinguish known facts from unknowns.

affected_service.description: The name of the service, application, or device explicitly reported as affected or damaged. Never return a service explicitly stated to be working normally. Leave blank if no affected service, application, or device is named.

owner.description: The person explicitly assigned as the incident owner or engineer

impact.description: The passage describing affected users and the business impact

category.description: The primary technical category supported by the report

severity.description: Assess urgency using the severity rubric in shared instructions

major_incident.description: Do the explicitly stated facts meet the major-incident criteria in shared instructions?

change_approved.description: Has an authorized person explicitly approved the proposed remediation change? Absence of approval is not approval.

stakeholder_update.description: Draft a concise update for affected employees in English, at most three sentences. Include the reported impact, current workaround if any, and next known action. Do not invent restoration times, approvals, or technical root causes.

impact.value: all 18 members of the payroll team

stakeholder_update.value: The payroll portal is currently unavailable due to an SSO authentication error, impacting the payroll team's ability to submit this month's payroll. There is currently no workaround available. Engineers are proposing a rollback of this morning's identity configuration change, pending approval from the change manager
